content.short: IntelliJ Solidity Plugin provides one of the most popular Solidity plugins to write, test, debug, and deploy smart contracts.
content.description: IntelliJ Solidity Plugin is a popular choice among Solidity developers and is regarded as a leading plugin for Solidity, praised for its benefits. Once integrated, the plugin can format code and provide efficient syntax highlighting, supporting cleaner and more consistent Solidity code. These benefits contribute to its status as a widely used tool in Solidity development. However, it remains limited since it only supports Solidity and does not extend to other languages.
